if abs(dz-TOL_LIFT)>0.02 and dz < 0.05:

import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current
from held import measure_held_head, tcp_axes, PAD
from moves import tgt, measure_tube
from pol import detect_holes

ARM="left"; HOLE_I=0
TIP_PRE=0.90
TIP_DESCENTS=[0.790,0.800,0.812,0.825]
TOL_TILT=2.0
TOL_XY=0.003

def link_for_tip(tip_target, dtip, A, Zl):
    return np.asarray(tip_target,float) - dtip*Zl - PAD*A

obs=current()
holes=detect_holes(obs.camera("head"))
row1=[h for h in holes if h["floor_z"]>0.768]
hole=row1[HOLE_I]["c"]; print("hole",np.round(hole,4).tolist())
p,R=tcp_axes(obs,ARM); A=R[:,0]; Zl=R[:,2]
print("tcp",np.round(p,4).tolist(),"A",np.round(A,4).tolist(),"Zl",np.round(Zl,4).tolist())

# 1) pre-insert
pos=link_for_tip(np.array([hole[0],hole[1],TIP_PRE]), -0.0748, A, Zl)
rd=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(pos,R,"precision")}, speed="normal", dry_run=True)
print("pre dry:",rd.feasible,"|",rd.summary)
if not rd.feasible: handoff("pre-insert infeasible", summary=rd.summary)
r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(pos,R,"precision")}, speed="normal", exact_orientation=True)
print("pre move:",r.status,r.failure_code,r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok: handoff("pre move failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)

# 2) measure, correct orientation + position
obs2=current()
m=measure_held_head(obs2,ARM)
if m is None: handoff("cannot measure held tube at pre-insert")
print("meas tip",np.round(m["tip"],4).tolist(),"dtip",round(m["dtip"],4),"tilt",round(m["tilt"],3),"n",m["n"],"ax",np.round(m["ax"],4).tolist())
print("orange",None if m["orange_center"] is None else np.round(m["orange_center"],4).tolist(), "n_orange",m["n_orange"])
tip_xy_err=float(np.linalg.norm(m["tip"][:2]-hole))
print("tip xy err",round(tip_xy_err,4))
if m["tilt"]>12: handoff("implausible tube tilt",tilt=m["tilt"])
need_corr = m["tilt"]>0.7 or tip_xy_err>TOL_XY
Ruse=R.copy()
if need_corr:
    Rc,_=Rotation.align_vectors(np.array([[0.,0.,1.]]), np.array([m["ax"]])); Rc=Rc.as_matrix()
    print("corr deg",round(float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip((np.trace(Rc)-1)/2,-1,1)))),3))
    p_cur=m["grasp"]-PAD*m["A"]
    tip_rot=p_cur+Rc@(m["tip"]-p_cur)
    A1=Rc@m["A"]; Zl1=Rc@m["Zl"]
    dtip1=float((tip_rot-p_cur)@Zl1)
    pos1=link_for_tip(np.array([hole[0],hole[1],TIP_PRE]), dtip1, A1, Zl1)
    Ruse=Rc@R
    r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(pos1,Ruse,"precision")}, speed="normal", exact_orientation=True)
    print("corr move:",r.status,r.failure_code,r.target_error_m,r.target_error_deg)
    if not r.ok: handoff("correction move failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
    obs2=current()
    m=measure_held_head(obs2,ARM)
    if m is None: handoff("cannot measure after correction")
    print("after corr: tilt",round(m["tilt"],3),"tip",np.round(m["tip"],4).tolist(),"dtip",round(m["dtip"],4))

tip_xy_err=float(np.linalg.norm(m["tip"][:2]-hole))
if m["tilt"]>TOL_TILT or tip_xy_err>TOL_XY:
    handoff("pre-insert inaccurate", tilt=m["tilt"], xy_err=tip_xy_err)

# 3) vertical descent to the lowest feasible release height
Zcur=np.asarray(obs2.pose(ARM).position.xyz,float)
dtip=m["dtip"]; A=m["A"]; Zl=m["Zl"]
p_cur=m["grasp"]-PAD*A
chosen=None
for tipz in TIP_DESCENTS:
    target=link_for_tip(np.array([hole[0],hole[1],tipz]), dtip, A, Zl)
    rd=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(target,Ruse,"precision")}, speed="normal", dry_run=True)
    print("descend tipz",tipz,"feasible",rd.feasible,"|",rd.summary)
    if rd.feasible:
        chosen=(tipz,target,rd); 
        if "least clearance" in (rd.summary or "") and " 0 mm" in rd.summary: 
            continue
        break
if chosen is None: handoff("no feasible descent target")
tipz,target,rd=chosen
print("chosen tipz",tipz,"link6",np.round(target,4).tolist())
r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(target,Ruse,"precision")}, speed="normal", slow_approaching=True, exact_orientation=True)
print("descend:",r.status,r.failure_code,r.target_error_m,r.contact)
if not r.ok: handoff("descent failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)

# 4) verify depth reached
obs3=current()
m3=measure_held_head(obs3,ARM)
if m3 is None: handoff("cannot measure at depth")
z_err=float(m3["tip"][2]-tipz); xy_err=float(np.linalg.norm(m3["tip"][:2]-hole))
print("at depth tip",np.round(m3["tip"],4).tolist(),"z_err",round(z_err,4),"xy_err",round(xy_err,4),"tilt",round(m3["tilt"],3))
if z_err>0.012: handoff("descent stopped early (contact)", z_err=z_err, tip=m3["tip"].tolist())

# 5) release
rg=tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM:"open"}); print("open:",rg.status,rg.ok,rg.measured_opening)
# 6) retract
p_now=np.asarray(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz,float)
retract=p_now+np.array([0,0,0.12])
rd=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(retract,Ruse,"free_space")}, speed="normal", dry_run=True)
print("retract dry:",rd.feasible,"|",rd.summary)
r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(retract,Ruse,"free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("retract:",r.status,r.failure_code)
# 7) verify placed tube
obs5=current()
mt=measure_tube(obs5.camera("head"), near=np.array([hole[0],hole[1],0.86]), max_dist=0.10, Lrange=(0.03,0.17))
if mt is None: handoff("placed tube not measurable", hole=hole.tolist())
up=float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(abs(mt["ax"]@np.array([0,0,1.])),-1,1))))
print("placed: c",np.round(mt["c"],4).tolist(),"ax",np.round(mt["ax"],4).tolist(),"L",round(mt["L"],4))
print("tip",np.round(mt["tip"],4).tolist(),"mouth",np.round(mt["mouth"],4).tolist(),"mouth_col",mt["mouth_col"],"tip_col",mt["tip_col"])
print("upright_dev",round(up,2),"mouth_z",round(float(mt["mouth"][2]),4),"mouth_xy_err",round(float(np.linalg.norm(mt["mouth"][:2]-hole)),4))

import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current
from held import tcp_axes, PAD, measure_axis_wrist, measure_collar_head
from moves import tgt, measure_tube
from pol import detect_holes

ARM="left"; HOLE_I=0
DTIP=-0.0748; DMOUTH=0.042      # measured in-hand geometry at the lift pose (tube 0)
LTOT=DMOUTH-DTIP
TIP_PRE=0.905
TOL_TILT2=1.5; TOL_XY2=0.003
DESCENT=[0.795,0.800,0.810,0.820]

obs=current()
holes=detect_holes(obs.camera("head")); row1=[h for h in holes if h["floor_z"]>0.768]
hole=row1[HOLE_I]["c"]; print("hole",np.round(hole,4).tolist())
p,R=tcp_axes(obs,ARM); A=R[:,0]; Zl=R[:,2]; grasp=p+PAD*A
aw=measure_axis_wrist(obs,ARM); ch=measure_collar_head(obs,ARM)
if aw is None or ch is None: handoff("measurement failed", aw=aw is None, ch=ch is None)
axis=aw["axis"]
tilt0=float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(axis@np.array([0,0,1.]),-1,1))))
tip=ch["mouth_top"]+DTIP*axis
print("axis",np.round(axis,4).tolist(),"tilt0",round(tilt0,2),"n",aw["n"])
print("mouth_top",np.round(ch["mouth_top"],4).tolist(),"tip",np.round(tip,4).tolist())
print("check tip vs model",np.round(grasp+DTIP*axis,4).tolist())
if tilt0>10: handoff("implausible tilt", tilt=tilt0)

# --- correction: make the tube vertical, tip at (hole, TIP_PRE) ---
Rc,_=Rotation.align_vectors(np.array([[0.,0.,1.]]), np.array([axis])); Rc=Rc.as_matrix()
R_new=Rc@R
tip_h=R.T@(tip-p)
tip_target=np.array([hole[0],hole[1],TIP_PRE])
p_new=tip_target-R_new@tip_h
print("corr dist deg",round(float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip((np.trace(Rc)-1)/2,-1,1)))),2),"p_new",np.round(p_new,4).tolist())
rd=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(p_new,R_new,"precision")}, speed="normal", dry_run=True)
print("corr dry",rd.feasible,"|",rd.summary)
if not rd.feasible: handoff("correction infeasible", summary=rd.summary)
r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(p_new,R_new,"precision")}, speed="normal", exact_orientation=True)
print("corr move",r.status,r.failure_code,r.target_error_m,r.target_error_deg)
if not r.ok: handoff("correction failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)

# --- verify upright + aligned ---
obs2=current()
aw2=measure_axis_wrist(obs2,ARM); ch2=measure_collar_head(obs2,ARM)
if aw2 is None or ch2 is None: handoff("verify measurement failed")
axis2=aw2["axis"]; tip2=ch2["mouth_top"]+DTIP*axis2
tilt2=float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(axis2@np.array([0,0,1.]),-1,1))))
xyerr=float(np.linalg.norm(tip2[:2]-hole))
print("after corr: axis",np.round(axis2,4).tolist(),"tilt",round(tilt2,2),"tip",np.round(tip2,4).tolist(),"xyerr",round(xyerr,4),"mouth_z",round(float(ch2["mouth_top"][2]),4))
Ruse=R_new; p_use=np.asarray(obs2.pose(ARM).position.xyz,float)
if tilt2>TOL_TILT2 or xyerr>TOL_XY2:
    # second correction
    Rc2,_=Rotation.align_vectors(np.array([[0.,0.,1.]]), np.array([axis2])); Rc2=Rc2.as_matrix()
    R_new2=Rc2@Ruse
    tip_h2=Ruse.T@(tip2-p_use)
    p_new2=tip_target-R_new2@tip_h2
    print("corr2 deg",round(float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip((np.trace(Rc2)-1)/2,-1,1)))),2))
    r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(p_new2,R_new2,"precision")}, speed="normal", exact_orientation=True)
    print("corr2",r.status,r.failure_code,r.target_error_m,r.target_error_deg)
    if not r.ok: handoff("second correction failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
    Ruse=R_new2
    obs2=current()
    aw2=measure_axis_wrist(obs2,ARM); ch2=measure_collar_head(obs2,ARM)
    axis2=aw2["axis"]; tip2=ch2["mouth_top"]+DTIP*axis2
    tilt2=float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(axis2@np.array([0,0,1.]),-1,1))))
    xyerr=float(np.linalg.norm(tip2[:2]-hole))
    print("re-verify tilt",round(tilt2,2),"xyerr",round(xyerr,4))
    if tilt2>TOL_TILT2 or xyerr>TOL_XY2: handoff("alignment still off", tilt=tilt2, xyerr=xyerr)

# --- descend ---
p_now=np.asarray(obs2.pose(ARM).position.xyz,float)
chosen=None
for tz in DESCENT:
    target=p_now+np.array([0,0,tz-tip2[2]])
    rd=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(target,Ruse,"precision")}, speed="normal", dry_run=True)
    print("descend tipz",tz,"feasible",rd.feasible,"|",rd.summary)
    if rd.feasible:
        chosen=(tz,target,rd.summary)
        if " 0 mm" not in (rd.summary or ""): break
if chosen is None: handoff("no feasible descent")
tz,target,sm=chosen
print("descent to tipz",tz,"target",np.round(target,4).tolist())
r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(target,Ruse,"precision")}, speed="normal", slow_approaching=True, exact_orientation=True)
print("descend",r.status,r.failure_code,r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok: handoff("descent failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)

obs3=current()
ch3=measure_collar_head(obs3,ARM); aw3=measure_axis_wrist(obs3,ARM)
if ch3 is None: handoff("cannot verify at depth")
exp_mouth=tz+LTOT
print("at depth mouth_z",round(float(ch3["mouth_top"][2]),4),"expected",round(exp_mouth,4),"tilt",round(float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(aw3["axis"]@np.array([0,0,1.]),-1,1)))),2) if aw3 else None)
if ch3["mouth_top"][2] > exp_mouth+0.008:
    handoff("descent stopped short (contact)", mouth_z=float(ch3["mouth_top"][2]), expected=exp_mouth)

# --- release, retract, verify ---
rg=tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM:"open"}); print("open",rg.status,rg.ok,rg.measured_opening)
p_rel=np.asarray(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz,float)
ret=p_rel+np.array([0,0,0.13])
rd=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(ret,Ruse,"free_space")}, speed="normal", dry_run=True)
print("retract dry",rd.feasible,"|",rd.summary)
r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt(ret,Ruse,"free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("retract",r.status,r.failure_code)
